description:
Goal
Regression target for the unified root fz-f98. The shared reduce bridge over non-List Enumerables must not produce an unresolved multi-surface callable at the settled_callable_boundary consumer.

Symptom (one face of the fz-f98 root)
- Enum.reduce(1..7//2, fn(x, acc) -> x * acc end) (reduce/2 over Range): native callable materialization for CallableId(1) names multiple boundaries [0,1,2]; a multi-surface callable value must arrive through a publication position.
- Enum.reduce_while(%{2=>:two,1=>:one}, [], fn({k,v},acc) -> if k < 2 do {:cont,[v|acc]} else {:halt,acc} end end) (reduce_while/3 over Map): same class, CallableId(0) names multiple boundaries [0,1].

Why it is the fz-f98 root: the same captured-callable-over-non-List decorrelation, surfacing at settled_callable_boundary (which hard-errors) rather than at lane decode. This is also the reachable instance of the multi-surface callable phenomenon discussed in fz-x2n; fz-x2n's own deterministic fallback is proven dead, and the genuine multi-surface handling is subsumed by the fz-f98 root fix.

Required work (verification; fix is in fz-f98)
- Pin fixtures: reduce/2 over Range and reduce_while/3 over Map, on interp + run + build.
- After the fix, a multi-surface callable value either arrives through a publication position naming its surface or is selected soundly; never papered over with pick-first.

Checks
- New regressions green on all three paths.
- range_enumerable + map_enumerable remain green.
- cargo test --lib and cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings.

RE-VERIFIED AT HEAD (fz-f98.19 stack tip). BOTH stated symptoms PASS in
isolation. This ticket looks stale; confirm and close.

    fn main() do
      range = 1..7//2
      dbg(Enum.reduce(range, fn (x, acc) -> x * acc end))
    end
    => 105                              (reduce/2 over Range: OK)

    fn main() do
      map = %{2 => :two, 1 => :one}
      dbg(Enum.reduce_while(map, [], fn ({k, v}, acc) -> {:cont, [{k, v} | acc]} end))
    end
    => [{2, :two}, {1, :one}]           (reduce_while/3 over Map: OK)

No `settled_callable_boundary` multi-surface error on either. Found while
re-triaging the deferred `enum_tier0` fixture, which cited this ticket among
four blockers; two of the other three (fz-bfh.1, fz-bfh.4) are already closed.

Before closing, check whether the multi-surface error needs a DIFFERENT repro
than the two above -- the ticket title names the mechanism, and it is possible
the mechanism survives while these two surfaces stopped triggering it. If no
repro can be produced at HEAD, close it.

title: Enum.reduce/2 over Range and reduce_while/3 over Map hit settled_callable_boundary multi-surface error
